name: Chain brute
description: a big plated grey demon of the Cracked Road in rough iron plates, a thick chain bolted to its left wrist trailing off to the left, wall-like shield arm held forward, orange cracks glowing between the plates

poses.stand: standing square, shield arm forward, chain taut to the left, facing right
poses.dead: collapsed forward, chain slack on the ground

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
